N-1.1-A.skill: distinguish total distance (path length) from displacement (signed net change in position) when a position function reverses direction

N-1.1-B.skill: compute signed average acceleration through a rebound where velocity changes sign, avoiding speed-difference and reversed-sign errors

N-1.2-A.skill: use the relative signs of velocity and acceleration, obtained by differentiating, to decide speeding up or slowing down

N-1.2-B.skill: recognize that average velocity is displacement over time (area under v-t) and not the endpoint average or midpoint value when acceleration is not constant

N-1.3-A.skill: find final position from a velocity-time graph as initial position plus signed area, with segments below the axis counted negative

N-1.3-B.skill: locate maximum velocity where acceleration is zero and compute it by integrating a(t) plus the initial velocity

N-1.4-A.skill: use relative (closing) speed in one dimension for pursuit and approach, then convert time back to ground-frame distance for one object

N-1.4-B.skill: resolve a river-crossing problem into independent perpendicular motions in the ground frame: crossing time from the boat's cross-stream speed, drift from the current

N-1.5-A.skill: solve two-dimensional projectile motion launched from a height with a quadratic for the time of flight, using separate horizontal and vertical components

N-1.5-B.skill: obtain speed as the magnitude of the velocity vector found by differentiating each position component, not from |r|, components sum, or acceleration
